PraisonAIUI ships three built-in operational plugins for long-running and recurring agent work: Schedules (builtin.cron): Recurring agent tasks with natural-language or cron schedules (hourly, daily, */30m, cron:0 9 * * 1-5, at:ISO), backed by config.yaml and wired into agent schedule tools. Jobs (builtin.jobs): Async job submission, progress tracking, live stats and cancellation. Work / Kanban (builtin.work): Built-in task board (work, jobs-board, kanban) plus the composable aiui.board(columns=[...]) component for custom pages.

Feature Key endpoints Schedules GET /api/schedules, POST /api/schedules, POST /api/schedules/{id}/run, POST /api/schedules/{id}/stop, GET /api/schedules/{id}/stats Jobs GET /api/jobs, POST /api/jobs, GET /api/jobs/stats, GET /api/jobs/{id}, POST /api/jobs/{id}/cancel Kanban GET /api/kanban, POST /api/kanban/cards, PUT /api/kanban/cards/{id}, DELETE /api/kanban/cards/{id}

Combine aiui.status() (with refresh_every) and aiui.board() in any @aiui.page handler: Show the built-in pages in your sidebar with aiui.set_pages(["chat", "cron", "jobs", "work"]) or aiui.set_pages("all").
